full_name: Caroline Elkins | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2012–2013 History ACLS Frederick Burkhardt Fellow Harvard University
bio: Caroline Elkins is a professor of history and African and African American studies at Harvard University and the chair of its Committee on African Studies and Committee on Ethnic Studies. Her first book, Imperial Reckoning: The Untold Story of Britain’s Gulag in Kenya (Henry Holt, 2005), was awarded the 2006 Pulitzer Prize in general nonfiction. Her work has been covered in international newspapers, magazines, and television and radio programs.
